executive_summary.text: Current ownership interests reported to CMS: SECURECARE OPTIONS LLC (5% Or Greater Direct Ownership Interest); ELIEZER D KRAUSZ (5% Or Greater Indirect Ownership Interest); LTC ASSOCIATES LLC (5% Or Greater Indirect Ownership Interest); MONTEFIORE INVESTMENT TRUST (5% Or Greater Indirect Ownership Interest); ROCKY ASSOCIATES LLC (5% Or Greater Indirect Ownership Interest); UNIVERSAL GENERAL TRUST (5% Or Greater Indirect Ownership Interest); CHRISTOPHER S WRIGHT (5% Or Greater Indirect Ownership Interest); VANTAGE CAPITAL INVESTORS LLC (5% Or Greater Indirect Ownership Interest).
Cost year 2025: the home reported $618,405 in management fees (cost report line m12), $18.51 per resident day (Connecticut median $13.39 among homes reporting a fee).
Cost year 2025: total nursing pool (agency) fees on the report were $450,498, of which $30,211 is counted in direct care.
CMS lists 16 health citations for this home between 2019-01-14 and 2026-09-02, including 0 at actual harm or immediate jeopardy level (0 immediate jeopardy).
In 2026Q2, total nurse staffing was 4.28 hours per resident day (RN 0.51, LPN 1.02, aides 2.74); the Connecticut median that quarter was 3.82.
Contract (agency) staff made up 1.3% of nursing hours in 2026Q2 (Connecticut median 3.8%).
Missing data: Cost year 2025 raw food is not used: not comparable (food bought by a contractor, lines do not add up, or missing).

tables.description: Only years that passed the site's checks. check_status 'unvalidated' means the printed totals did not fully reconcile; treat those figures as provisional. Statewide medians use validated reports only.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
